equivalence_basis.statement: Poses of this pallet that differ only by a multiple of 90 degrees about canonical +Y are defined as equivalent, because (i) the registered footprint is square (x = 1.100 m, z = 1.100 m) and (ii) the physical pallet has fork pockets open on all four sides.

inspection_record.method: direct visual inspection of the physical pallet
inspection_record.finding: openings present on all four side faces (4-way entry)
inspection_record.artifact: user statement in session; no drawing or mesh in repository

equivalence_basis.claim_boundary: This contract states that 90-degree yaw differences are equivalent for POSE EVALUATION and for FORK INSERTION. It does NOT claim that the pallet is visually indistinguishable under 90-degree rotation: the top deck pattern was not assessed for 4-fold symmetry, and no claim is made that a vision model cannot or should not distinguish the phases.

inclusion_exclusion_rules: The equivalence applies to the pallet body's canonical geometric pose.
All four yaw phases separated by multiples of 90 degrees are equivalent, because the canonical X and Z extents are equal (1.100 m each) and all four sides admit fork entry.
Cargo, straps, fixtures, and directional attachments are outside the symmetric pallet-body definition and must not be used to expand or contract the accepted rotation set.

This contract governs POSE metrics only. It does NOT license mixing keypoint index conventions: an index-wise 2D keypoint metric still requires that training labels and evaluation labels use the same index assignment. See challenge/config/KEYPOINT_FIELD_CONTRACT.json.
This contract applies ONLY to plastic_standard_110x110x15. The paper objects plastic_standard_110x130x11 and wood_small_80x59x14 keep their own contracts and are unaffected.
why_this_object_differs_from_the_paper_o: challenge/real_gt_v2/SYMMETRY_CONTRACT.json excludes 90 degrees with the reason 'the canonical X and Z extents differ' (1.10 m vs 1.30 m). That reason does not hold here: this object's X and Z extents are equal. The two contracts are therefore consistent, not contradictory.
provenance_note: Written 2026-09-06 during _docs/audits/accuracy_root_cause_v1. Development results on this object had already been observed at that time (challenge_c4_track). This contract is therefore NOT pre-registered, and any number reported under it is a DEVELOPMENT result. It was fixed to resolve a label-convention defect, not to select a model.
